en: Black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk. On the right, signage for shops and a confectionery & café is visible; in the distance a tram or carriage is on the street and a church spire and hilltop castle or large building rise above the town. Printed red text at the top names the town and street; publisher information appears at the bottom.
